title: Battery or bad habits?
hook: A fast-draining battery doesn’t always mean you need a new phone.
story_outline: Show a shop-owned iPhone; check symptoms/settings; explain diagnosis; show battery replacement only if justified; finish with a documented test.
shot_list: Phone exterior with notifications off; technician explanation; battery-health screen with identifiers hidden; parts shot; test result.
review_notes: Use a shop-owned/demo phone. Do not show customer photos or notifications. Never stage a fake result or promise a specific battery life.
cta: Ask for a model-specific assessment through a confirmed business contact channel.

title: The screen replacement trade-off
hook: Two replacement screens can have very different results.
story_outline: Compare the listed aftermarket LCD option with the original display type; explain trade-offs; show an honest test; invite model-specific questions.
shot_list: Cracked demo screen; labeled part; side-by-side approved demo; touch test; technician closing.
review_notes: Confirm the exact panel SKU and limitations. Do not describe the LCD as an original OLED or advertise the planning price as a firm quote.
cta: Ask for a model-specific assessment through a confirmed business contact channel.

title: Broken screen. What about my photos?
hook: A broken screen and lost data are different problems.
story_outline: Use a demo phone; explain restoring access versus recovering deleted files; show a backup workflow without real personal content; explain referral limits.
shot_list: Shop-owned damaged display; test screen exterior; generic backup progress; technician talking to camera.
review_notes: No passcode bypass or deleted-data guarantee. Check current Apple/Google guidance before filming; use only dummy accounts and files.
cta: Ask for a model-specific assessment through a confirmed business contact channel.

title: Why is this laptop so loud?
hook: That fan noise is a clue, not a diagnosis.
story_outline: Capture a genuine symptom; inspect fan/airflow; explain the compatible replacement; show the same test after service.
shot_list: Demo laptop audio; exterior vents; disconnected fan; part number cropped; matching before/after test.
review_notes: Use the actual Latitude configuration and part. Power down for internal shots; do not imply every overheating fault needs a fan.

title: Repair it or replace it?
hook: A repair quote should help you decide, not pressure you.

shot_list: Demo laptop; compatible battery; simple estimate graphic; technician explaining options.
review_notes: Any price graphic must be rechecked and labeled estimate with exclusions. No invented replacement values or customer testimonial.

title: Back up before you need a rescue
hook: The best recovery appointment is the one you never need.

shot_list: Dummy backup screen; labeled external drive with no real account data; sample file verification; talking head.
